title: 前纽约联储主席达德利：AI热潮转向调整未必冲击金融体系
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Former New York Fed President Bill Dudley warning, if a bust might lie ahead, we should worry that the current boom may be sowing the seeds for a future financial crisis.
segments.zh: 前纽约联储主席比尔·达德利警告，如果市场下行即将到来，我们应该担心当前的繁荣可能正在为未来的金融压力埋下种子。

segments.en: Bill joins us now for more Bill. Great to see you. Thank you for being with us.
segments.zh: 比尔现在加入我们，比尔，很高兴见到你，感谢你的参与。

segments.en: I'm sure when you wrote that, you were not thinking about an affair at the second biggest company in the world. No, it's not. I'm sure that wasn't on your necessarily your big O'Card,
segments.zh: 我确信你写那篇文章时，并没有想到全球第二大公司会发生这种事。不，并不是。我确信那不一定在你的预期之中。

segments.en: but how much should the Fed be paying attention to turmoil right now in the tech trade?
segments.zh: 但美联储现在应该对科技交易中的市场波动给予多少关注？

segments.en: Well, I think they need to be paying attention for a couple of reasons. Number one, obviously, the AI trajectory has a big implications for the economic look, turns out strong
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为他们需要关注，原因有几个。第一，显然人工智能的发展轨迹对经济前景有重大影响，结果证明经济强劲。

segments.en: the economy is, and then also upward pressure on interest rates as AI demand is taking down a lot of credit. But the bigger question, I think longer term is, is AI going to go from boom to bust?
segments.zh: 然后还有利率的上行压力，因为人工智能需求正在吸收大量信贷。但更大的问题，我认为长期来看是，人工智能是否会从繁荣走向下行？

segments.en: And if it goes to bust, are we going to have a repeat of the grief financial crisis where the stress on the financial system caused things to fall apart? I think there I'm a little bit more
segments.zh: 如果它走向下行，我们是否会重演金融压力导致系统分崩离析的悲剧？我认为我有点更乐观。

segments.en: optimistic because, number one, people are talking about the risk of AI being up a bust.
segments.zh: 因为第一，人们正在讨论人工智能走向下行的风险。

segments.en: They really weren't talking about the great financial crisis occurring as we're going up to it.
segments.zh: 而在我们走向金融压力时，人们真的没有在讨论它会发生。

segments.en: Housing would never decline on a national basis. Subprime lending was risky. There were a lot of beliefs out there that sort of ruled out a great financial crisis. This time, people are talking
segments.zh: 地产市场永远不会全国性下跌。次级贷款有风险。当时有很多信念排除了金融压力的可能性。这一次，人们在讨论。

segments.en: about the AI boom turning into a bust. So what do you think should be done by regulators, by the Federal Reserve, to prevent it from getting to a level that could threaten the financial system?
segments.zh: 关于AI热潮可能转为低谷。那么您认为监管机构和美联储应该怎么做，以防止它发展到可能威胁金融体系的水平？
